source_text: In New York City from 2000 to 2011, health authorities documented 11 cases of infant HSV-1 following ritual circumcision with oral suction, resulting in two deaths and two cases of neurological damage; further incidents occurred post-2011, prompting regulatory efforts balanced against religious autonomy.
